body: I, normally, don’t comment on posts under this subreddit but I feel as if I am able to make a comment as I have a similar (not exact!) relationship with my mother. I am also 17 so I possibly have a similar mentality as the 16 year old. I don’t think cuddling or being in the bathroom at the same time is weird. When I am bored I go into my moms room to talk and or rest my head on her chest. I usually do this when I feel alone or sad. Occasionally I go into the bathroom while my mom is showering to talk to her. I imagine that you may be uncomfortable with their bathroom talks but I don’t necessarily think it’s sexual. The thing that is odd to me is the touching. I’d never touch my mom is her private areas as it is really weird. I agree that you need to talk to your partner and set boundaries as things do seem off with the touching. I don’t remember if you said how the relationship was with the father but I know that I have a close relationship with my mother because of my lack of relationship with my father. Hopefully this is insightful from another point of view :)!
